messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “best” month to visit Hawaii really depends on what you’re after, but most travelers find that **September or October** strike the perfect balance between great weather, lower crowds, and reasonable prices.

| What you want | Why September/October works |
|---------------|-----------------------------|
| **Weather** | Average highs around 82–84 °F (28–29 °C) with lower humidity than the summer months. |
| **Crowds** | Post‑summer lull means fewer tourists and shorter lines at popular spots. |
| **Prices** | Hotel rates and airfare dip after the peak summer season but before the holiday rush. |
| **Activities** | Ideal for beach days, snorkeling, and hiking—rainfall is still low, and the ocean is calm. |

If you’re a big‑budget traveler looking for the absolute best deals, **April or May** are also excellent, especially for those who enjoy the lush spring scenery and want to avoid the summer crowds. Conversely, if you’re after the most vibrant festival scene, **December–January** (the Christmas/New Year period) is the time to go, but expect higher prices and larger crowds.

So, for a blend of pleasant weather, fewer crowds, and good value, September or October is usually the sweet spot.
